notes: Round-trip a resharded directory: write the cratepack unpacker that reconstructs the original tree (exact names, nested dirs, byte-exact content) from chunk-scattered bucket blobs plus a manifest. Medium: validate-then-write contract, path-safety rejection, empty files, exact-multiple and off-by-one chunk tails, binary payloads, corrupt-digest and traversal manifests must fail cleanly with nothing written. Verifier re-executes the deliverable on the visible store and 4 hidden stores (2 valid trees checked file-by-file via SHA-256, 2 corrupt/unsafe cases that must exit non-zero with zero output files), and enforces the no-modify rule on /app/store.
